name: mt5-httpapi
description: MetaTrader 5 trading via REST: market data, orders, positions, history, and server-side technical analysis.

api_url.title: MT5 API URL
api_url.description: Server root of your running mt5-httpapi, e.g. http://localhost:8888, with no broker or account path and no trailing slash. The plugin's MCP server connects to <this URL>/mcp/, the unified endpoint where every tool takes broker and account parameters and list_terminals shows what is configured. A terminal path such as http://localhost:8888/roboforex/main pins the MCP server to that one terminal instead.

api_token.title: MT5 API token
api_token.description: Bearer token, sent as the Authorization header of the MCP server. Only needed if the API was started with authentication enabled.
